key_scientific_update.R10_observation: Exact Davis-Putnam projection under a frozen width cap of 4 stopped because the next elimination step required a width-5 intermediate resolvent.
key_scientific_update.R11_observation: The FINAL existential bridge relation itself is exactly representable by CNF clauses of width at most 4 on both frozen worlds.
key_scientific_update.consequence: The width-5 obstruction is therefore a COMPILATION/PATH obstruction on these worlds, not a lower bound saying the semantic interface requires width >4.
key_scientific_update.falsified_pretty_detail: These two interfaces do not require a representation language richer than width-4 CNF merely to describe the final relation.
key_scientific_update.surviving_model: REFERENCE_FRAME + EXACT_INTERFACE remains intact; the missing tooth is a polynomial exact compiler from the GENERAL_CNF frame to the compact width-4 semantic interface without temporary exponential/wide debt.

next_killer_test.name: R12_DIRECT_WIDTH4_INTERFACE_COMPILER
next_killer_test.proposal: Run fixed-width-4 resolution saturation directly on each frozen GENERAL_CNF frame, without Davis-Putnam variable elimination, branching, DPLL, or width widening. Collect only bridge-only consequences of width <=4 and compare their conjunction to the immutable exact R11 interface witness.
next_killer_test.why: A fixed clause width gives polynomially many possible clauses. Direct saturation may derive the final width-4 interface even though sequential elimination needs a temporary width-5 resolvent.
next_killer_test.pass: The derived bridge-only width<=4 clauses reproduce all and only the 135/127 allowed assignments and support proof-carrying replay.
next_killer_test.fail_or_open: If the saturation hull is larger than the exact interface, preserve the missing exact width<=4 prime implicates as witnesses that semantic clause width and derivation proof width differ. Do not widen or fall back to search.

claim_ceiling: Exact finite-relation characterization and minimum same-variable CNF clause width for two frozen bridge interfaces only. No global minimum representation language, polynomial arbitrary-CNF interface compiler, general SAT algorithm, or P-vs-NP result is established.
